newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rubber prices buoyant on low supply.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rubber prices buoyant on low supply.

text.p: Rubber prices rose in Colombo on Thursday despite overseas weakness, as rains affected supply, brokers said.
Lower supplies due to rain pushed up prices in Colombo despite the overseas market still being weak due to problems with the Thai baht, said a trader at brokerage Forbes & Walker.

Best latex one-x fetched 83.50 rupees ($1.4) per kg, compared to 80 last week. Number one rose to 82 rupees from 80, number two rose to 76.50 from 72.50 and number three to 70 from 68.50, brokers said. RSS1 was quoted for the first time in three weeks at 56.20. On offer was 249 tonnes. ($1=58.5) --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
